Presets form a tree: AI, Messengers, Social networks, Video hosting and Other services.
Other services is always last; all remaining categories and services are sorted alphabetically.

- Select a whole category or individual services. A mixed checkbox shows a partial selection.
- Expand categories and toggle checkboxes on mouse press, before release. Expanded groups and later choices stay visible while earlier requests finish.
- Individual AI services, Facebook, Instagram, X, Telegram and WhatsApp; GitHub and Reddit added.
- Broad domain masks, including desktop traffic observed for Claude, ChatGPT and Codex. Desktop process names appear with their services.
- Old aggregate selections migrate to individual services; edited user rules and deleted presets are preserved. Custom presets can be assigned a category.

The interface is rendered by Go with the existing embedded HTML and lightweight browser event handlers. No frontend framework or build pipeline is added.
